{{Quote|We are cheered by this victory but deeply disappointed that public servants could fail the Emperor so completely. Be confident that we will not relent until the prisoners have given up the names of their accomplices.|Armand Isard, on the senators' arrests|<ref name="Insider 84" />}}
'''Tanner Cadaman''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented [[Feenix/Legends|Feenix]] and the [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in the waning [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A member of the [[Delegation of 2000]] opposing the increasing executive power of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Cadaman attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and was shortly thereafter [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on charges of [[Treason/Legends|treason]].

==Biography==
By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Tanner Cadaman represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feenix/Legends|Feenix]] and its surrounding<ref name="Insider 85">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="SWC:TP" /> Cadaman was a signatory of the [[Petition of 2000]], joining a group of [[Senator/Legends|senators]] called the [[Delegation of 2000]]<ref name="Insider 84" /> in opposing [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]'s increase in executive power,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|103|Cadaman, Senator Tanner}}</ref> particularly the [[Sector Governance Decree/Legends|Sector Governance Decree]], a new system of regional [[Governor/Legends|governorship]].<ref name="Insider 84" />

Cadaman attended the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]] of his colleague Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> a fellow member of the Delegation,<ref name="Insider 84" /> in 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date" /> where he walked among senators in the funeral procession behind Amidala's coffin.<ref name="ROTS" /> Only [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later,<ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> following the [[Declaration of a New Order]] which formed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="Insider 84" /> Cadaman was part of the second group of senators to be [[Senatorial arrests/Legends|arrested]] at the directive of [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director]] [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]]<ref name="Insider 85" /> of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. Cadaman and sixty-two other members of the Delegation of 2000 were charged with conspiracy and [[Treason/Legends|treason]] in connection with an alleged [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] insurgency.<ref name="Insider 84" />

==Personality and traits==
Cadaman was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who possessed [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and fair skin.<ref name="SWC:TP" />

==Equipment==
At Senator Amidala's [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]], Cadaman wore a black and maroon [[Robe/Legends|robe]].<ref name="SWC:TP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tanner Cadaman appeared in the final film of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS" /> which released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="YbY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The funeral scene that featured the character was filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[September 16]], [[2003]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> The name "Tanner Cadaman" was first used in the article "[[Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241]]," which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|84th edition]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''<ref name="Insider84">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> on [[September 26]], 2005.<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref> The connection between the film character and the name was made by Japanese special edition of ''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]'', written by Hidalgo and [[Stephen J. Sansweet]]<ref name="SWC:TP" /> and released on [[October 27]], 2005.<ref name="SWCTP date">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/news20050817.html|text=Inside ''Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels''}}</ref>
